newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-INJURY FORCES WAQAR OUT OF SRI LANKA TOUR.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INJURY FORCES WAQAR OUT OF SRI LANKA TOUR.

text.p: Fast bowler Waqar Younis has been ruled out of Pakistan's tour of Sri Lanka just two days before the first test with a fractured left toe.
Waqar, who has taken 227 wickets in 44 tests, has been advised to rest for three weeks.
His fast bowling partner and Pakistan captain Wasim Akram is doubtful for the test starting on Saturday because of an arm injury.

"I'm really disappointed that I'm not able to play in Sri Lanka," Waqar said. "I like the country and I like to play here. I sorry to disappoint my fans. This is the first time in my career that I've suffered an injury of this nature."
Pakistan have asked fast bowler Mohammad Akram to replace Waqar but he is unlikely to arrive before the first test.
Sri Lankan opener Roshan Mahanama is doubtful for the test after injuring a toe during practice.
